svg.text: One brief · Four provider configurations · One launch batch · Independent provider results
Provider selection is multi-select. Each selected provider requires its own eligible account.
Shared business intent; provider-specific objective mapping happens in each adapter.
Default to account/provider rules; display explicitly.
Conditional fields depend on selected campaign recipe.
Performance Max: asset groups and required assets (File upload / asset selectors).
Campaign → ad set → creative → ad resources as required.
Page / Instagram identity (Account selector), format (Dropdown), media (File upload).
Campaign group, objective and creative requirements are account-dependent.
Target locations / industries / job roles (Multi-select or filters).
Page identity (Account selector), intro text (Textarea), headline (Text), creative (File upload).
Campaign → ad group → ad; eligible flow varies by objective and API.
Identity (Dropdown), video/image (File upload), ad text (Textarea), CTA (Dropdown).
Pixel/event selection (Dropdown) when required by the recipe.
One submission creates a batch; each provider operation has independent status.
Block launch if any selected provider is invalid.
Retry only eligible failed work · Save external resource IDs immediately · Never blindly retry an uncertain create request.
FIELD TYPES: Text · Textarea · URL · Dropdown · Multi-select · Checkbox · Radio group · Toggle · Number · Read-only ·
Date picker · Date-time · Account selector · Entity selector · Tag input · File upload · Range slider · Asset selector
Design note: illustrative MVP recipe fields only. Final options are filtered by account permissions, provider capability schema and API version.
